# M11 follow-up register and additional-source decision

The nine required sources have been assessed in order. Four promising mechanisms
remain open after those assessments; the separate model-route retirement is an
operational admission gate. `PLAN.md` owns their completion state.

| ID | Unresolved gap | Existing evidence and local boundary | Next acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| M11-NOV-01 | Does result-conditioned per-draft search find known prior art without falsely rejecting distinct ideas? | [Sakana dossier](sakana-ai-scientist.md); current validation synthesis already receives per-draft analyses and has retrieval tools, but its follow-up use is unmeasured. | Paired exact-source recall, distinct controls, provenance and one-search cap through the existing validation path. |
| M11-LLM-02 | A provider may accept a call whose response is lost, then a retry may send it again. | [OpenScience dossier](synthetic-sciences-openscience.md); local LiteLLM and durable-task retry boundaries need native-timeout and BYOK tests. | Offline lost-response reproduction, truthful unknown outcome, explicit owner recovery and bounded admitted-free recovery. |
| M11-GWAS-07 | Variant-level curated association lookup is absent from the current tool set. | [ToolUniverse dossier](mims-harvard-tooluniverse.md); the [official v2 endpoint now returned a keyless record](tooluniverse/m11-gwas-live-response.json). | Registered MCP tool with bounded pagination/errors, real response, study/effect provenance and association caveat. |
| M11-ROBIN-01 | An owned empirical result is visible but cannot yet target a hypothesis follow-up. | [Robin dossier](future-house-robin.md); local outcome rows are append-only, while current steering is run-wide. | Explicit owner action, selected-outcome targeting, restart-safe idempotency and unchanged review/safety/Elo gates. |
| M11-OPS-02 | The selected free route advertises retirement on 25 September 2026. | [Campaign procedures](campaign.md) and [M10 receipt](robin/m10-free-route-2026-09-24.json); request-level cost admission fails closed. | Fresh official price and production-role readback after retirement; bounded actual-interface check before a replacement default or further inference. |

## Additional repository selection

**Selected: zero.** Each unresolved mechanism has a pinned required-source
comparison and an exact local or official-service boundary to test. No proposed
additional repository supplies a distinct missing mechanism or a provider-backed
replay guarantee that these investigations require. Another general Co-Scientist
clone would duplicate the nine required implementation comparisons; another
broad tool catalog would not establish the GWAS service's live behavior or terms.
Those categories are excluded for this campaign, not assessed as defective
software. If a concrete gap appears during the remaining acceptance work, record
its evidence in `PLAN.md` before reconsidering this decision; the three-source
ceiling and the existing turn limit remain.
